name: Sketch
description: Mark places, draw and point out routes and areas on the table from a phone

about.purpose: Lets everyone contribute: people mark places, routes and areas on the table from their phones.
questions: Where do you go, and what would you change?
Which places feel unsafe, loved or missing?
limits: A phone adds words to its own last mark only; there is no voting on marks yet

controls.label: Take back my last mark
controls.help: From a phone, takes back that phone's last mark; from the controller, the last mark anyone made.

controls.label: Add to my last mark
controls.help: Words for the phone's last mark. The controller shows them; the table shows only a small ring that the mark has words.

controls.label: Show what the phones said
controls.help: The words phones add to their marks, on the controller. Off until someone running the table turns it on, as visitors' words go on a shared screen.
